## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Note prerequisites or checks not run.
For visible changes, include screenshots using synthetic data and note mobile,
keyboard, light-theme and dark-theme checks.

## Release notes

Note migrations, configuration changes and compatibility concerns, or write
“None.” Add a changeset for public SDK behavior or packaging changes. Identify
upstream material and preserve its license and attribution notices.
